resources.string: A little preparation.\nMore peace of mind.
Your essentials and household plans, together in one private place.
Planning progress is not a guarantee of safety. Follow local authorities during an emergency.
General planning information, not live alerts. For other countries, consult your local emergency-management authority.

Source: UK Government Prepare
https://prepare.campaign.gov.uk/get-prepared-for-emergencies/
Reviewed: 28 October 2026 · Content version 1
Source update date: not supplied. This summary is stored offline. The source link needs internet access.

Push to talk, then review the transcript. Recognition and spoken feedback use installed device services, which may process audio or spoken text over the network. PrepTrove does not save recordings. Read private plans aloud only when you are comfortable with your speech provider and surroundings. English commands are available.

No PrepTrove account or ads. The app adds no publisher analytics and does not automatically upload household records or track location. Amazon distribution and optional device services may process data under their own terms. Records are stored in this app’s private device storage. Device encryption depends on your device settings.
Interface: English preview. Other languages are pending translation and review. Voice and speech capabilities depend on installed device services.
Reminders are checked periodically, usually daily. Timing is controlled by the operating system. Mark complete to pause; edit the date to snooze.
PDF, CSV and JSON exports are unencrypted. PTB backups use password-protected encryption. Review the included information before saving.
This cannot be undone. Supplies in a deleted kit will become unassigned.
